name: Borbs
voice: Playful, warm and irresistibly cute. Borbs turns the world's most underrated, quirky animals into round, squishy, huggable little characters. Joyful and a little witty, collector-friendly, kind — speaks to kids, teens, animal lovers and grown-up plush collectors alike. Fun first, but genuine about softness, comfort and quality.
photo_rules: BRIGHT, PLAYFUL, HIGH-KEY and cute — clean white/warm-cream #FFF4EC backgrounds, a cheerful teal #2FA79B + coral #FF7A59 accent world, soft rounded shapes and friendly rounded-sans type. HERO the plush BIG and visibly PLUMP/full — the #1 review complaints are 'under-stuffed / flat' and 'smaller than expected', so ALWAYS show it fully stuffed AND give an honest SIZE reference (in a hand, next to a mug/ruler, '12 in / 30 cm'). Show the adorable realistic rock-hyrax (dassie) charm, the super-soft cotton texture in macro, and the internal SENSORY FIDGET BEADS as a tactile feature (calming/comforting — never a medical claim). Show the joyful use-cases: cuddle, shelf/desk decoration, a growing Borbs collection, take-anywhere, and gifting. Kid-safe and wholesome (ages 3+). English overlays, PUNCHY (<=5 words), one cute idea per image.
no_gos: NO medical / therapeutic claims — the sensory beads are 'calming', 'soothing', 'comforting', a 'sensory' feature; NEVER 'treats/relieves anxiety, stress, ADHD, autism' or any condition. No 'best / #1 / guaranteed'. Be HONEST about size — never imply it is bigger than 12 x 5 x 5 in (do not stage it to look large). No choking-hazard or safety over-claims beyond the listing (ages 3+). Keep it wholesome and kid-safe; no scary or edgy styling. No prices/URLs on-image. Colours stay cheerful and on-brand — no dull or dark moods.
